Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game then! The Kiwis are yet to be beaten in this tour. Ireland will have two more chances as there are two T20Is left. The next one is a must-win for them if they are to stay in this series. The second T20I will be played on the 20th July, the game is all set to begin at 8.30 pm IST (3.00 pm GMT). But as you all know our build-up will begin in advance. Do join us then. For now, it's goodbye!

Mitchell Santner the captain of New Zealand says that it was not easy to bat, but the way Glenn Phillips played was exceptional. He show great composure and batted well along with James Neesham on a niggly wicket. Mentions that if it was not for Glenn Phillips, they would probably have only 140 on the board which would not have been enough. Mentions that Lockie Ferguson bowled well, and he showed everyone how good he can bowl on this sluggish wicket.

Andy Balbirnie the skipper of Ireland says that they started off well, and bowled well in the Powerplay. But New Zealand batted well and set an above-par total. Mentions that they had a really poor Powerplay while coming to bat, and that took the game away from them. Adds that they had decent partnerships in the middle but nothing substantial.

Glenn Phillips is the Player of the Match. He says that Ireland did bowl upfront, but the wicket was a bit sticky. Mentions that it was a good recovery from them after the start they good and he thought that 150 was a par score, so it was good to get over 170.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Early on in the match, Ireland won the toss and put the Kiwis to bat first. They too started well with the ball but gave away a few runs towards the end which helped New Zealand set a target of 174. While coming to bat, none of their batters found any sort of rhythm, and they started falling like a pack of cards and were eventually dismissed for 142.

After posting a total of 173 on the board, the visitors got off to a perfect start. They destroyed the top order of Ireland and put them under the pump early on. Lockie Ferguson did the damage earlier on which really dampened the chances of the home side. The Irish did manage to get after the spinners but it was the pacers who kept their cool and helped them to take a 1-0 lead. Lockie Ferguson ended with 4 wickets, while Mitchell Santner and James Neesham both grabbed two wickets.

Ireland started the innings positively. Andy Balbirnie played some fine strokes but he perished soon and three wickets followed him thereafter. There were some decent knocks from a few middle and lower-order batters but someone needed to kick on that is what did not happen. Mark Adair though did keep their hopes alive while he was there but it was too much to ask from him.

A comfortable win in the end for the Kiwis! That innings from Glenn Phillips made the difference! 170-plus on this wicket was always going to be a tough task and if you lose four in the Powerplay, it gets tougher.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Lockie Ferguson wraps things off! He takes his fourth wicket of the game! A shorter ball, down the leg side. Craig Young looks to get away from that one, but the ball flicks his gloves and goes towards the keeper. Dane Cleaver takes another good catch. The umpire raises his finger immediately after an appeal there, Craig Young though reviews. UltraEdge shows a slight spike as the ball passes the gloves. The on-field decision stays! New Zealand win by 31 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Sliding down leg, a length ball. Craig Young misses his flick and a wide is called!
A fuller ball, around middle. Josh Little manages to get an inside edge onto his pads and towards point. Single taken!

Angling in, on a length, sliding down leg. Craig Young looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no. New Zealand opt for a review. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking indicates it was sliding down leg. A review wasted here! Ireland need 34 runs off 12 balls.
Very full this time, outside off. Josh Little drives it through cover for a single.
On a length, outside off. Craig Young guides it to the fielder at short third man. Another run.
A slower ball, low full toss, around off. Josh Little drives it towards cover for a single.
Slower ball, outside off, on a length. Josh Little looks to have a poke at it but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length, outside off. Josh Little opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Another bouncer, outside off. Craig Young misses his pull.
Josh Little is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in the over for James Neesham. Ireland are now 9 down. Another short one, outside off. Mark Adair connects with his pull shot this time. But the ball goes off the toe end and towards deep mid-wicket. Glenn Phillips takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b James Neesham

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Short again, outside off. Mark Adair looks to pull this one but he misses.
A low full toss, on the pads. Mark Adair flicks it towards square leg for a brace.

OUT! TAKEN! That's a good catch! An important wicket at a crucial time for New Zealand! Back of a length, around middle. Barry McCarthy looks to pull this one but the ball goes off the top edge and over short fine leg. Ish Sodhi there runs, keeps his eyes on the ball, and takes a terrific catch. James Neesham grabs his first wicket! Craig Young is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b James Neesham

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter one, slower, outside off. Mark Adair looks to cut this one but the ball goes off the bottom edge and towards point. Single taken!
Flatter, quicker, down leg. Barry McCarthy looks to pull this one but he misses. 44 needed off 24 balls.
Back of a length, slower one, outside off. Mark Adair cuts it towards point for a run.
Fires this one quick, full, around middle. Barry McCarthy pushes it to long on for a single.
Outside off, shorter one. Mark Adair pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Full, down the leg side. Mark Adair walks across and looks to flick this away but he misses. The keeper fails to grab the ball as well. It races away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full and around off. Mark Adair looks to reverse-sweep this one but he misses.
Wide! Loopy ball, full and spinning away, wide of off. Mark Adair leaves it alone.
FOUR! Back of a length, outside off. Mark Adair waits for it and cuts it away from short third man for a boundary.
Good shot and a much better stop! Too full this time, outside off. Barry McCarthy drives it through cover. The fielder runs to his left, slides, and makes a good stop. Two taken!
A low full toss, around middle. Mark Adair knocks it down to long on for a single.
On a length, outside off, a slower one. Mark Adair looks to cut this one away but he misses.
James Neesham hits the deck hard again, and serves a short ball, around middle. Mark Adair stays in his crease and looks to cut this away but he misses.
Short again, outside off. Mark Adair slaps this one wide of long on for a brace.
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, back of a length. Mark Adair throws his bat at it but he misses.
Wide of off, shorter one. Mark Adair cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Too short, around off. Mark Adair pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, and on the pads. Barry McCarthy flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Mark Adair drives it through sweeper cover for a single.
A wrong'un this time, short, around middle and leg. Mark Adair looks to pull this one but he misses.
FOUR! Short and a leg break, outside off. Mark Adair stays in his crease and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Full and outside off. Mark Adair drives it towards mid off and takes a quick single.
On a length, outside off. Barry McCarthy pushes it towards cover for a run. 100 up for Ireland!
A slower yorker, wide off. Barry McCarthy fails to dig this one out. Nothing off the Free Hit!
No ball! A slower one this time, another bouncer, around off. Barry McCarthy misses his pull again. A no ball called! Free Hit coming up.
A shorter ball, around middle and off. Barry McCarthy looks to pull this but he misses.
A fuller one, around middle. Barry McCarthy heaves it over mid-wicket. Two taken!

OUT! LBW! Lockie Ferguson comes back into the attack and strikes on his very first delivery! His third wicket overall and Ireland have lost 7 now! A yorker-length delivery, on middle. Curtis Campher looks to reverse-scoop this but he misses. The ball goes on to hit him on his boot. A loud appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Curtis Campher though decides to review this. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows three reds and Curtis Campher walks back.
Lockie Ferguson is back on!
Two as this is worked through square leg.
On middle, this is swept to deep mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! Dockrell's breezy little innings comes to an end! He steps out, this is shorter and on middle, it is hit flat towards long on where it is taken by Ferguson. Timely wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Lockie Ferguson b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! GD backs away to the leg side, he is followed. He looks to push it on the off side but misses.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
Shorter and outside off, Campher looks to cut but is beaten.

FOUR! Dockrell has come out all guns blazing! Back-to-back big overs for the Irish. Just the 82 needed in 9 now. Angled into the pads, this is whipped over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Momentum towards Ireland now.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! This is a hit-me ball! Short and wide outside off, it is cut over point for a boundary.
Short and this is pulled through square leg for one.
Shorter, some extra bounce. Campher looks to work it on the leg side but it hits the splice and goes on the off side.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for two.
FOUR! Just wide and runs flowing now! The paddle scoop comes out, it is full and outside off. It is dragged just wide of the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
Daryl Mitchell comes into the attack.
Two to end! Dockrell on the charge! On off, this is lofted over covers for two.
FOUR! Really well played from Dockrell! He moves across, this is on middle, it is swept behind square on he leg side for a boundary.
On middle, this is tucked on the leg side for one.
Another single as this is pushed through covers.

DRINKS! New Zealand are all over Ireland at the moment! The hosts have already lost half their side and they find themselves in deep trouble for now. They still need 105 runs from 64 balls to get over the line. Well, the runs are not an issue, it's the wickets for Ireland.

OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket for New Zealand and Ireland have half their side back in the hut! Shorter and outside off, Tucker looks to cut but it goes off the outside edge back to the keeper. Dane Cleaver does well to grab the ball.
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Fires this in full and outside off, it is jammed out towards point for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to covers.
Excellent running! This is turning out to be a huge over! On middle, this is pushed towards mid on for two.
SIX! That is a huge hit! On middle, the slog sweep is out, it is nailed over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for Ireland! They need a few more! Tossed up outside off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary.
Tucker comes down the track, she turns into a low full toss, it is hit down to long off for one.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
This is worked with the angle through square leg for one more.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Steps out and the length is shortened. Defended.
Swept, on middle, this is hit through square leg for one.
Shorter and around off, this is played to point.
Half an appeal but probably slipping down leg! The googly, it lands on middle and turns back in. Tucker looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
A single now as this is pushed through covers.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Campher chops it on the off side for one.
WIDE! A false start! Down the leg side. Wided.
Ish Sodhi comes into the attack!
FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, around the hips. Lorcan Tucker walks across and flicks it fine towards fine leg for a boundary. Ireland are 41 for 4 at the end of the Powerplay!
Shorter and around middle and leg. Lorcan Tucker tucks it towards square leg.
Tosses it up, full and around off. Lorcan Tucker pushes it towards cover.
Lorcan Tucker is the new man in!

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Ireland are in all sorts of trouble! The skipper strikes now! A shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Harry Tector stays in his crease and looks to cut this away but the ball goes off the outside edge towards short third man. Ish Sodhi there takes a good catch. Ireland have lost their fourth wicket within the Powerplay!
Commentary.Howout: c Ish Sodhi b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Harry Tector pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
FOUR! Up and away! Full, around off. Harry Tector makes room and goes inside-out over cover for a boundary.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in the over for Lockie Ferguson! It's the slower ball that has done the trick once again. Short and wide of off, at around 114 clicks. Paul Stirling waits for it and slaps it towards cover. Glenn Phillips there leaps and takes a good catch. Early trouble for Ireland! Curtis Campher walks out to bat!
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off. Harry Tector drives it towards mid off for a single.
Beaten! Lovely ball! Tad shorter, nipping back in, outside off, data round 144 clicks. Harry Tector looks to cut this away but he gets beaten on the inside edge.
On middle, a length ball. Harry Tector blocks it out.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! A fuller ball, tailing back in, down leg. Harry Tector looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. That was sliding down leg.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Lockie Ferguson comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! Well bowled! Gareth Delany departs for a timid score. A length ball, tailing back in, tad slower as well. Gareth Delany looks to heave this one but he misses due to the lack of pace. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Ireland are 2 down!

SIX! IN THE END! Excellent effort though from Mitchell! On middle, this is heaved towards deep mid-wicket. Mitchell runs to his left, he takes it but then realises he is going over the ropes, tries to throw it back in but does so over the ropes itself. He then hops and looks to push it back in but in the process his feet touch the ground.
Daryl Mitchell tries his best to stop the ball. But the replays show that the ball was in his hand while he touched his foot onto the ground inside the boundary. Six runs!
That has taken off! Length and outside off, Stirling looks to heave it on the leg side but gets a top edge onto the body.
Shorter and outside off, Stirling looks to pull but misses.
BEATEN AGAIN! Shorter and outside off, Stirling looks to upper cut it but misses.
Length and on off, Delany pushes it through covers and takes one.
FOUR! Easy pickings! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and the ball races away to the fence. No stopping that.
James Neesham is introduced into the attack.
A good comeback in the end by Duffy! Angled into the pads, Stirling looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Gareth Delany walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH THAT IS! Stunning from Santner! Andy Balbirnie steps out, this is on a length and on off. He looks to loft it over covers but it goes more off the splice. It seems like it has enough to clear mid off. Santner runs back and takes it with a dive. Good wicket as Balbirnie was looking nice.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Jacob Duffy

Commentary.Commentary: A dot! Shorter and around off, this is cut towards point. Phillips fumbles but no run conceded.
FOUR! Up and over! Ireland have begun brilliantly! Full and outside off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary. Second in the over.
Angled into the pads, Andy works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Shorter and outside off, this is cut over point for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, this is hit towards mid off for one more.
Shorter in length and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Going down leg! Angled into the pads, Paul looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Well bowled! A yorker now on middle, this is jammed out to covers.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Stirling walks across and looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Two! Shorter and outside off, this is cut over point for a couple.
Around off, Andy guides it through point for one.
Who will bowl from the other end? Lockie Ferguson it is!
Swing and a miss! So 5 from the first over! Shorter and on middle, Stirling looks to go over mid-wicket but misses.
WIDE! Way too short, it is ducked under.
Another one on the fuller side, kept out.
On off, defended.
On middle, fuller, Stirling looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Not off the middle but the result he wanted! Short and down the leg side. Stirling looks to pull, it goes off the inside edge fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Some swing! Fuller and on off, this shapes away. It is pushed to cover.
